scope: Near-equilibrium frozen-core RHF/CCSD(T) pilot; correlation-model and dissociation qualification remain open
method: spherical RHF/CCSD(T), two frozen occupied spatial orbitals, ten correlated electrons
dipole_method: all-electron CCSD lambda density, not a CCSD(T) energy derivative
relative_energy_reference: Each basis uses its own R=2.1323-bohr energy

held_point_check.knots: Thirteen points on the 0.05-bohr grid, plus R=2.1323
held_point_check.held_points: Twelve independent interval midpoints on the 0.025-bohr grid

acceptance: Every used point requires converged RHF/CCSD/lambda, internal/external RHF stability, finite amplitude diagnostics and a 14-electron density; failed references stop before CCSD(T)
diagnostic_budgets: Predeclared pilot thresholds; passing does not establish the correlation treatment or a complete neutral potential

execution.layout: One sequential worker after the stretched-basis owner and import-checkpoint diagnostic complete
